summary: This plugin adds an Auto mode to DeepSeek Harness that automatically handles permission-gated tool calls using configured rules, review logic, and optional confirmation prompts.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Evidence in the repository shows this plugin is primarily an approval-automation extension for DeepSeek Harness: it adds an Auto mode permission preset and intercepts user confirmation-required tool calls so they are handled through rule checks, optional LLM review, and prompt-based fallback. Its core behavior is changing how tool invocation permissions are decided in-session rather than adding domain tools. Because it can auto-approve and only then optionally ask for confirmation, its impact is operational risk in tool execution flow, and it depends on outbound model calls and configured policies.
